name: Member Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the live status of a member of a system.

ENBL.name: Enabled
ENBL.definition: Member is live on the system.

DSBL.name: Disabled
DSBL.definition: Member is temporarily not live on the system.

DLTD.name: Deleted
DLTD.definition: Member is no longer live on the system.

JOIN.name: Joining
JOIN.definition: Member is joining and will soon be enabled on the system.
